overlays.label: 21 CFR Part 11 audit-trail candidate
overlays.applicability: Opt in only after a qualified reviewer determines that 21 CFR Part 11 applies to the closed system and electronic records; this is one audit-trail measure, not complete Part 11 coverage.

patterns.template: {{system}} shall produce a time-stamped, attributable audit trail for at least {{target}} percent of record changes in {{scope}} under {{conditions}}.

scope.description: Named, versioned task, interface, event or scenario inventory; must be nonempty.

conditions.description: Approved measurement plan: environment, workload/cohort, observation window, oracle, aggregation and exclusions.

target.description: Stakeholder-approved acceptance bound; no framework-prescribed default is implied.

metric.measurement: Review every create, modify and delete event against actor/time/change evidence; full applicable coverage requires a target of 100 and separate retention/tamper-protection requirements.

provenance.derivation: curator-authored; framework-informed measurement, not a normative ISO mapping

overlays.label: HIPAA audit-control candidate
overlays.applicability: Opt in only for reviewed covered-entity/business-associate ePHI scope; audit-event coverage alone does not satisfy the HIPAA Security Rule.

patterns.template: {{system}} shall record reviewable audit evidence for at least {{target}} percent of ePHI activities in {{scope}} under {{conditions}}.

scope.description: Named, versioned task, interface, event or scenario inventory; must be nonempty.

conditions.description: Approved measurement plan: environment, workload/cohort, observation window, oracle, aggregation and exclusions.

target.description: Stakeholder-approved acceptance bound; no framework-prescribed default is implied.

metric.measurement: Freeze the risk-assessed event inventory; verify retained evidence supports examination of each recorded activity.

provenance.derivation: curator-authored; framework-informed measurement, not a normative ISO mapping

overlays.label: PCI DSS data-retention candidate
overlays.applicability: Opt in only after PCI scope and any issuer-specific provisions are reviewed; this checks post-authorization storage of sensitive authentication data, not full PCI DSS compliance.

patterns.template: {{system}} shall retain at most {{target}} sensitive-authentication-data records in {{scope}} after authorization under {{conditions}}.

scope.description: Named, versioned task, interface, event or scenario inventory; must be nonempty.

conditions.description: Approved measurement plan: environment, workload/cohort, observation window, oracle, aggregation and exclusions.

target.description: Stakeholder-approved acceptance bound; no framework-prescribed default is implied.

metric.measurement: Inspect persistent stores, logs and backups after authorization; the referenced prohibition requires target 0, not an adjustable tolerance.

provenance.derivation: curator-authored; framework-informed measurement, not a normative ISO mapping

overlays.label: WCAG 2.2 web-accessibility candidate
overlays.applicability: Opt in for a reviewed web-content accessibility policy; this single keyboard-access measure is not a WCAG conformance assessment.

patterns.template: {{system}} shall provide keyboard operation for at least {{target}} percent of the applicable functionality in {{scope}} under {{conditions}}.

scope.description: Named, versioned task, interface, event or scenario inventory; must be nonempty.

conditions.description: Approved measurement plan: environment, workload/cohort, observation window, oracle, aggregation and exclusions.

target.description: Stakeholder-approved acceptance bound; no framework-prescribed default is implied.

metric.measurement: Use manual keyboard tests and review path-dependent-input exceptions; all applicable functionality requires target 100.

provenance.derivation: curator-authored; framework-informed measurement, not a normative ISO mapping

overlays.label: Section 508 web-content candidate
overlays.applicability: Opt in only for reviewed Section 508 web-content scope; E205.4 incorporates WCAG 2.0 A/AA, not WCAG 2.2; this single criterion does not cover the entire rule.

patterns.template: {{system}} shall provide keyboard operation for at least {{target}} percent of the applicable web functionality in {{scope}} under {{conditions}}.

scope.description: Named, versioned task, interface, event or scenario inventory; must be nonempty.

conditions.description: Approved measurement plan: environment, workload/cohort, observation window, oracle, aggregation and exclusions.

target.description: Stakeholder-approved acceptance bound; no framework-prescribed default is implied.

metric.measurement: Review WCAG 2.0 keyboard criterion applicability and exceptions; all applicable functionality requires target 100.

provenance.derivation: curator-authored; framework-informed measurement, not a normative ISO mapping
